M26 — 2026-10-10
Merge-back with peers on main: build mergeback/<tag> on LOCAL main in the release worktree (ask peers to hold commits), then git merge --ff-only it in the shared worktree and push. A non-ff git merge in the shared worktree aborts, because peers' staged files dirty the index.
